objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most health at end of run

entries.text: Take the Oasis shortcut (pick up the ammo, weapon and rad chests on 11 before killing anything)
Fight Horror (Don't pick up any rad canisters)
You are only allowed to pick up explosive or melee weapons, carrying one of each
